This '''planet''' was the location of a [[Battle of unidentified planet (Yoda's chaingun)|battle]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] defeated an entire [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] army using only a giant [[Chaingun/Legends|chaingun]].
